name: Noachian-Fjard
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, massive canyon systems emerge like the bones of the planet.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
